title: GPT-5 System Card
paper_type_zh: 前沿系统卡与数据披露账本
best_for_zh: 需要审计路由训练、安全完成、测试时计算及前沿模型披露边界的读者
one_line: The GPT-5 System Card discloses broad source classes, reinforcement-learning reasoning, continuous router training on model switches, preference rates, and measured correctness, safe-completions, and parallel test-time compute, but not the underlying records or reproducible reward and data contracts.
GPT-5 System Card 报告路由器持续利用模型切换、偏好率和测得正确性训练，以及 safe-completions 和 thinking-pro 的并行测试时计算；其支撑数据和训练配方仍未披露。
why: It offers a useful Track 12 ledger of a routed frontier system while making visible the boundary between post-training disclosure, safety evaluation, deployment safeguards, and benchmark evidence.
inclusion_reason: A frontier-system report that discloses broad training-source classes, reinforcement-learning reasoning, real-time router feedback signals, safe-completions, and parallel test-time compute while leaving the underlying records, reward contracts, split, and lineage unavailable.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Frontier model reports can mix four evidence layers that answer different questions: disclosures about training data, descriptions of post-training feedback, safety or capability evaluations, and safeguards applied at deployment. Treating any one layer as proof of another obscures what can actually be audited. A benchmark result does not reveal the records that produced a model, and an end-to-end safeguard result does not isolate the effect of training.

GPT-5 makes this boundary especially important because the released product is a unified system rather than a single static model. OpenAI describes a fast model, a deeper reasoning model, a real-time router, mini fallbacks, and a parallel test-time-compute setting called gpt-5-thinking-pro. Track 12 therefore asks what data objects and feedback contracts are actually disclosed for the models and router, which evaluation evidence is reported, which controls operate only at deployment, and what remains unavailable.

This Card is scoped to the August 7, 2025 launch system card. It does not merge later GPT-5 addenda or successor reports into the launch disclosure.

前沿模型报告常把四类回答不同问题的证据放在一起：训练数据披露、后训练反馈描述、安全或能力评测，以及部署阶段采用的保障措施。若把其中任一层当作另一层的证明，就会模糊真正可审计的内容。benchmark 结果不会揭示生成模型的训练记录，端到端保障结果也不能单独归因于训练。

GPT-5 尤其需要这一区分，因为发布的产品是统一系统，而不是单个静态模型。OpenAI 描述了快速模型、深度推理模型、实时 router、mini fallback，以及名为 gpt-5-thinking-pro 的并行测试时计算设置。因此，Track 12 关注模型与 router 实际披露了哪些数据对象和反馈契约、报告了哪些评测证据、哪些控制只在部署时运行，以及哪些信息仍不可得。

本卡片仅覆盖 2025 年 8 月 7 日发布时的 system card，不把后续 GPT-5 addenda 或继任模型报告并入首发披露。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The disclosure ledger has four separate layers. First, OpenAI names three broad training-source classes: publicly available internet information, information accessed through third-party partnerships, and information provided or generated by users, human trainers, and researchers. It also reports rigorous quality and risk filtering, reduction of personal information, and use of the Moderation API and safety classifiers. No source manifest, mixture, count, date range, record, or rights map is released.

Second, the report identifies post-training mechanisms. GPT-5 reasoning variants are trained to reason through reinforcement learning. The real-time router is continuously trained on real signals: user model switches, preference rates for responses, and measured correctness. Safe-completions center safety training on the assistant output and seek to maximize helpfulness subject to safety-policy constraints. A sycophancy score derived from production-representative conversations is also described as a reward signal. These are useful contract-level clues, but the examples, graders, reward functions, aggregation, calibration, and optimization artifacts are unknown.

Third, the report presents safety, factuality, deception, red-team, chain-of-thought, and Preparedness evaluations. Fourth, it describes deployment mitigations such as routing, prompt-injection defenses, system-level biological protections, account-level enforcement, API controls, and a Trusted Access Program. Evaluation items and deployment controls must not be relabeled as training data unless the report explicitly connects them to training.

披露账本包含四个彼此独立的层次。第一，OpenAI 只列出三类宽泛训练来源：公开互联网信息、通过第三方合作获取的信息，以及用户、human trainers 和 researchers 提供或生成的信息。报告还称采用严格的质量与风险过滤、减少个人信息，并使用 Moderation API 和 safety classifiers。来源清单、混合比例、数量、时间范围、记录和权利映射均未发布。

第二，报告点名若干后训练机制。GPT-5 推理变体通过强化学习来学习推理；实时 router 持续使用真实信号训练，包括用户切换模型、回答 preference rates 和 measured correctness。safe-completions 以 assistant output 的安全性为中心，并在安全政策约束下最大化 helpfulness。报告还把由 production-representative conversations 得到的 sycophancy score 描述为训练 reward signal。这些是有价值的契约级线索，但样例、graders、奖励函数、聚合、校准和优化制品均为 unknown。

第三，报告给出安全性、事实性、欺骗、red-team、chain-of-thought 和 Preparedness 评测。第四，它描述 routing、prompt-injection 防御、生物风险 system-level protections、account-level enforcement、API controls 和 Trusted Access Program 等部署缓解。除非报告明确把某项内容连接到训练，否则不能把评测条目或部署控制改称训练数据。

title: Method
方法
html:
At the model-data layer, OpenAI reports a diverse proprietary mixture drawn from the three source classes and a filtering pipeline that targets quality, risks, personal information, and harmful or sensitive content. The report does not disclose preprocessing rules, thresholds, deduplication, mixture weights, versions, yields, train/evaluation membership, or item-level provenance. It says the reasoning variants learn through reinforcement learning to refine their thinking, try strategies, recognize mistakes, and follow model policies, but it does not publish the trajectories, feedback, rewards, or optimizer.

At the system layer, the router chooses among gpt-5-main and gpt-5-thinking paths according to conversation type, complexity, tool needs, and explicit user intent. Continuous router training uses model switches, response-preference rates, and measured correctness. Once usage limits are reached, mini variants handle remaining queries. The report does not define the routing record schema, how correctness is measured, how conflicting signals are combined, the update cadence, exploration policy, thresholds, or failure logs.

At the safety-training layer, safe-completions replace a brittle prompt-intent comply/refuse boundary with an output-centric objective: maximize helpfulness under safety-policy constraints. The system card reports production comparisons and controlled experiments, but the separate official safe-completions paper is methodological context rather than a release of GPT-5 training records. Targeted post-training is also described for sycophancy and graceful failure on infeasible tasks. Exact datasets, labels, graders, reward models, and stage weights remain unknown.

At inference, gpt-5-thinking-pro applies parallel test-time compute. The number of parallel attempts, selection or aggregation rule, scheduling, and budget are not disclosed. At deployment, biological-risk controls add model training, system-level protections over production traffic, account enforcement, API identifiers, and access programs; this stack is not a single training verifier.

在模型数据层，OpenAI 报告了由三类来源组成的多样化专有混合，以及面向质量、风险、个人信息和有害或敏感内容的过滤管线。报告没有披露预处理规则、阈值、去重、混合权重、版本、产量、训练/评测成员关系或条目级溯源。它称推理变体通过强化学习来改进思考、尝试不同策略、识别错误并遵循 model policies，但没有发布 trajectories、feedback、rewards 或 optimizer。

在系统层，router 根据 conversation type、complexity、tool needs 和显式 user intent，在 gpt-5-main 与 gpt-5-thinking 路径之间选择。router 持续使用 model switches、response-preference rates 和 measured correctness 训练；达到使用限额后，mini variants 接管剩余查询。报告没有定义 routing record schema、正确性如何测量、冲突信号如何组合、更新频率、探索策略、阈值或失败日志。

在安全训练层，safe-completions 用 output-centric objective 取代脆弱的基于 prompt intent 的 comply/refuse 边界：在安全政策约束下最大化 helpfulness。system card 报告了生产对比和受控实验，但独立的官方 safe-completions 论文只是方法背景，不是 GPT-5 训练记录发布。报告还描述了针对 sycophancy 以及不可完成任务中 graceful failure 的定向后训练；具体 datasets、labels、graders、reward models 和阶段权重仍为 unknown。

在推理阶段，gpt-5-thinking-pro 使用并行测试时计算，但并行尝试数量、选择或聚合规则、调度和预算均未披露。在部署阶段，生物风险控制叠加 model training、覆盖生产流量的 system-level protections、account enforcement、API identifiers 和 access programs；这一整套防御不是单个训练 verifier。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official GPT-5 System Card supports the launch architecture, data-source classes, filtering, reinforcement-learning reasoning, router signals, safe-completions, evaluations, and safeguards. Its Model Data and Training section is the evidence for training disclosure; the many later evaluation sections are not substitutes for missing training records.

The card reports several concrete evaluation results. On production-representative factuality prompts with browsing, an LLM grader had 75% human agreement on factuality judgments; relative to GPT-4o and OpenAI o3, gpt-5-main and gpt-5-thinking respectively had 44% and 78% fewer responses containing at least one major factual error. On SimpleQA without web access, reported accuracy was 0.55 for gpt-5-thinking versus 0.54 for OpenAI o3, with hallucination rates of 0.40 and 0.46. For sycophancy, offline scores were 0.145 for GPT-4o, 0.052 for gpt-5-main, and 0.040 for gpt-5-thinking; preliminary online prevalence for gpt-5-main fell 69% for free users and 75% for paid users relative to GPT-4o. These results characterize evaluated behavior, not training-data quality or reproducibility.

The report also records counterevidence and scope limits. Some gpt-5-main disallowed-content categories regress relative to GPT-4o, including statistically significant regressions for hate/threatening and sexual/exploitative. Comparison values for live predecessor models may differ from their launch values. Ordinary safety evaluations were not rerun for gpt-5-thinking-pro; gpt-5-thinking results are treated as proxies even though pro uses parallel test-time compute.

OpenAI treats gpt-5-thinking as High capability in the Biological and Chemical domain as a precaution and activates associated safeguards while stating that definitive evidence for the threshold is absent. This is a risk-management decision supported by capability and safeguard assessments, not a disclosed training-data label.

官方 GPT-5 System Card 支持首发架构、数据来源类别、过滤、强化学习推理、router signals、safe-completions、评测和保障措施等陈述。其中 Model Data and Training 部分才是训练披露证据；后续大量评测章节不能替代缺失的训练记录。

系统卡报告了若干具体评测结果。在启用浏览、代表生产对话的事实性 prompts 上，LLM grader 与人类对事实性的判断一致率为 75%；相较 GPT-4o 和 OpenAI o3，gpt-5-main 与 gpt-5-thinking 含至少一项重大事实错误的回答分别减少 44% 和 78%。在无网页访问的 SimpleQA 上，gpt-5-thinking 与 OpenAI o3 的准确率分别为 0.55 和 0.54，hallucination rates 分别为 0.40 和 0.46。sycophancy 离线分数为 GPT-4o 0.145、gpt-5-main 0.052、gpt-5-thinking 0.040；gpt-5-main 的初步在线 prevalence 相较 GPT-4o 在免费用户和付费用户中分别下降 69% 与 75%。这些结果刻画的是被评估行为，不是训练数据质量或可复现性的证明。

报告也记录了反例和范围限制。gpt-5-main 在部分 disallowed-content 类别上相较 GPT-4o 退步，其中 hate/threatening 和 sexual/exploitative 的退步具有统计显著性。在线前代模型的对比值可能不同于其首发值。常规安全评测没有在 gpt-5-thinking-pro 上重新运行；尽管 pro 使用并行测试时计算，报告仍把 gpt-5-thinking 结果当作代理。

OpenAI 出于谨慎把 gpt-5-thinking 按 Biological and Chemical 领域的 High capability 处理并启用相应保障，同时明确称尚无达到该阈值的决定性证据。这是由能力与保障评估支持的风险管理决定，不是已披露的训练数据标签。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
This is not a data release. Its distinctive Track 12 value is a partial, multi-layer disclosure of a routed frontier system. The report names real router feedback signals rather than only saying that routing exists, describes output-centric safe-completion training rather than only listing a refusal policy, and identifies parallel test-time compute as a separate inference setting. Together these disclosures expose more of the system boundary than a single-model benchmark table would.

The report is also useful because it makes several attribution boundaries visible. Production-representative conversations appear as evaluation inputs and, for sycophancy, as the basis for a score used as a reward signal; the card does not establish that every production benchmark enters training. Biological safeguards combine training and operational controls. Factuality, safety, and capability results measure behavior under specified graders and settings, not the quality, legality, coverage, or provenance of the training mixture.

The novelty for this atlas is therefore the disclosure ledger itself: coarse source categories, a few named feedback fields, a safety objective, a routed inference scaffold, and an extensive release audit, paired with explicit unknowns. It is not a reproducible GPT-5 recipe, a released router dataset, or proof that benchmark gains came from a particular data intervention.

这不是数据发布。它对 Track 12 的独特价值，是对 routed frontier system 所做的多层次、但仍不完整的披露。报告不只说存在 routing，还点名真实 router feedback signals；不只列出拒答政策，还描述 output-centric safe-completion training；并把并行测试时计算识别为独立推理设置。相较单模型 benchmark 表，这些内容揭示了更多系统边界。

报告还使若干归因边界清晰可见。代表生产对话的数据既作为评测输入出现，也在 sycophancy 场景中用于形成训练 reward signal；但系统卡没有证明每个 production benchmark 都进入训练。生物风险保障结合了训练与运营控制。事实性、安全性和能力结果衡量的是特定 grader 与设置下的行为，不是训练混合的质量、合法性、覆盖度或溯源。

因此，本图谱记录的创新点是披露账本本身：粗粒度来源类别、少量明确反馈字段、一项安全目标、routed inference scaffold 和广泛的 release audit，并与显式 unknowns 配对。它不是可复现的 GPT-5 配方、已发布 router dataset，也不能证明 benchmark 提升来自某个特定数据干预。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The system card does not release pretraining or post-training examples, source manifests, token or sample counts, mixture weights, collection dates, source-level rights, opt-in handling, deduplication, decontamination, filtering rules or yields, preference records, measured-correctness records, sycophancy labels, safe-completion examples, reasoning traces, reward functions or models, calibration, optimizer settings, rollouts, schedules, checkpoint lineage, or training environments.

The router cannot be reproduced from the report. Its inputs are described conceptually and three training signals are named, but record schemas, sampling, correctness measurement, preference aggregation, objectives, thresholds, exploration, update cadence, traffic allocation, fallbacks, failure rates, and logs are unavailable. Parallel test-time compute is similarly high level: attempts, selection, aggregation, latency/cost budgets, and per-task allocation are unknown.

Evaluation disclosure is uneven. Some public factuality benchmarks and grading prompts are identified, but most safety, production, red-team, chain-of-thought, and Preparedness items and complete outputs are unavailable. LLM graders introduce measurement dependence; the reported 75% human agreement for one factuality grader is not a full error audit. Live predecessor comparisons can drift, and gpt-5-thinking-pro relies on proxy safety results rather than dedicated reruns.

Deployment safeguards create attribution limits. Biological controls span model training, system-level protections, conversation scanning, human expert review, account enforcement, API safety identifiers, and access programs. End-to-end safeguard testing cannot isolate training effectiveness. The High capability treatment is precautionary, and the report explicitly says definitive threshold evidence is absent. No code, data, weights, or independent reproducibility package accompanies the card.

系统卡没有发布预训练或后训练样例、来源清单、token 或 sample 数量、混合权重、收集日期、来源级权利、opt-in 处理、去重、去污染、过滤规则或产量、preference records、measured-correctness records、sycophancy labels、safe-completion examples、reasoning traces、奖励函数或模型、校准、优化器设置、rollouts、schedules、checkpoint 谱系或训练环境。

无法从报告复现 router。其输入只在概念层描述，并点名三类训练信号，但 record schemas、sampling、correctness measurement、preference aggregation、objectives、thresholds、exploration、更新频率、流量分配、fallbacks、failure rates 和 logs 均不可得。并行测试时计算同样只做高层披露：尝试次数、选择、聚合、延迟/成本预算和逐任务分配均为 unknown。

评测披露并不均衡。部分公开事实性 benchmarks 和 grading prompts 得到识别，但多数 safety、production、red-team、chain-of-thought 和 Preparedness 条目与完整输出不可得。LLM graders 带来测量依赖；某个事实性 grader 的 75% 人类一致率不是完整误差审计。在线前代对比值可能漂移，gpt-5-thinking-pro 的安全结论依赖代理结果而非专门重跑。

部署保障造成归因限制。生物风险控制横跨 model training、system-level protections、conversation scanning、human expert review、account enforcement、API safety identifiers 和 access programs。端到端 safeguard testing 不能隔离训练效果。High capability 处理是谨慎性决定，且报告明确称缺少达到阈值的决定性证据。系统卡没有附带代码、数据、权重或独立复现包。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the assigned frontier-reports data-disclosure ledger, GPT-5 is a strong comparison case for systems whose behavior emerges from several coupled components. The Card lets auditors separately score: source disclosure, training-feedback disclosure, routing disclosure, inference-compute disclosure, evaluation transparency, and deployment-safeguard transparency. This prevents a long safety report from receiving credit for data fields it never publishes.

Use the Card to compare OpenAI's coarse source taxonomy with other frontier reports; map router signals into a candidate audit schema; identify where safe-completion, sycophancy, and graceful-failure objectives need item-level evidence; and flag parallel test-time compute as an inference variable when interpreting results. It can also guide requests for source manifests, routing logs, grader documentation, train/evaluation membership, and safeguard attribution.

Do not use the Card to reconstruct GPT-5, infer proprietary mixture proportions, claim that production evaluation conversations were generally used for training, treat safe-completion evaluation gains as a released reward contract, attribute biological-risk mitigation to training alone, or use benchmark performance as proof of data quality.

对指定的 frontier-reports data-disclosure ledger 而言，GPT-5 是研究多组件耦合系统的有力比较案例。本卡片使审计者可以分别评价：来源披露、训练反馈披露、routing 披露、推理计算披露、评测透明度和部署保障透明度。这样可以避免仅因安全报告很长，就给它从未发布的数据字段记分。

可以用本卡片比较 OpenAI 的粗粒度来源分类与其他前沿报告，把 router signals 映射为候选审计 schema，识别 safe-completion、sycophancy 和 graceful-failure objectives 需要哪些条目级证据，并在解释结果时把并行测试时计算标记为推理变量。它也可用于提出来源清单、routing logs、grader 文档、训练/评测成员关系和保障归因方面的补充请求。

不要用本卡片重建 GPT-5、推断专有混合比例、声称 production evaluation conversations 普遍用于训练、把 safe-completion 评测提升当作已发布奖励契约、把生物风险缓解只归因于训练，或用 benchmark 表现证明数据质量。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep the three broad training-source classes and filtering claims at category level; no source manifest, mixture, count, date range, rights map, or item lineage is available.
  • Record reinforcement-learning reasoning, router switches, response-preference rates, measured correctness, safe-completions, and the sycophancy reward signal as disclosed mechanisms, while preserving their examples, graders, reward functions, calibration, and optimization as unknown.
  • Separate standard, production-representative, public-benchmark, red-team, chain-of-thought, and Preparedness evaluations from training data; reported scores are behavioral evidence, not data-quality evidence.
  • Separate model training from deployment safeguards, including system-level biological protections, account enforcement, API controls, cached browsing after connector calls, and access programs.
  • Treat gpt-5-thinking results as proxy evidence for ordinary gpt-5-thinking-pro safety evaluations; those evaluations were not rerun under parallel test-time compute.
  • Keep the launch card separate from later GPT-5 addenda and successor system cards.

• 将三类宽泛训练来源和过滤陈述保持在类别层；来源清单、混合比例、数量、时间范围、权利映射和条目谱系均不可得。
  • 把强化学习推理、router switches、response-preference rates、measured correctness、safe-completions 和 sycophancy reward signal 记录为已披露机制，同时把样例、graders、奖励函数、校准和优化过程保留为 unknown。
  • 将标准评测、代表生产对话的评测、公开 benchmark、red-team、chain-of-thought 和 Preparedness 评测与训练数据分开；报告分数是行为证据，不是数据质量证据。
  • 将 model training 与 deployment safeguards 分开，后者包括生物风险 system-level protections、account enforcement、API controls、connector 调用后的 cached browsing 和 access programs。
  • 将 gpt-5-thinking 结果视为 gpt-5-thinking-pro 常规安全评测的代理证据；这些评测没有在并行测试时计算设置下重跑。
  • 将首发 system card 与后续 GPT-5 addenda 和继任模型 system cards 分开。
